sentences.en: Humble and not imaginative, Justin only knew evil through hearsay.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，Justin既谦逊又缺乏想象力，只知道通过听别人说来了解邪恶。

sentences.en: The global press praised him as an exceptionally imaginative director.
sentences.zh: 全球媒体称赞他是一位极具创新力的导演。

sentences.en: You have an imaginative, artistic and pretty romantic personality.
sentences.zh: 你具有丰富的想象力、艺术感和浪漫情怀。

senses.zh: 富于想像力的，运用想像力的,想象或创造出来的,沉溺于想象的,虚假的
